explanation: The image-to-video approach and identical start/end references are appropriate, but the plan treats requested silence, duration and aspect as guaranteed generator outputs. It lacks finishing steps to remove generated audio and enforce delivery specifications. Matching endpoint pictures also does not guarantee smooth motion across the loop boundary, so repeated playback needed verification.
better_chain: image (create a calm mountain lake with an uncluttered centre) → image-to-video (animate subtle ripples with a locked camera and matching start/end references) → video-edit (remove all audio) → assemble (enforce exactly 6 seconds and 16:9 while preserving the loop endpoints) → gate (check actual duration, dimensions, silence, visible motion and repeated end-to-start playback; revise if needed)

steps.issue: Appropriate tool and landscape prompt; the resulting scene provides a calm centre suitable for a heading.

Appropriate animation tool, references and motion settings, but its generated output cannot be assumed to have exact dimensions, duration, silence or seamless boundary motion without finishing and verification.

missing: Explicit audio removal, exact-duration/aspect finishing, and a final check of actual specifications and repeated loop-boundary playback. Identical endpoint images alone do not establish perceptually seamless motion.
